name: Oracle NetSuite
status: Draft profile: column names follow NetSuite's standard saved search labels; confirm against the customer's first export and edit here, not in code.
how_to_export: The customer's NetSuite admin creates five saved searches with exactly these columns, filtered to the quarter, and exports each as CSV with the file name below.
PO Lines: Transaction search, Type = Purchase Order, Main Line = false, Tax Line = false. Columns: Document Number, Date, Name, Item, Class, Quantity, Item Rate, Amount, Approval Status, Created By.

PO Approvals: Transaction search, Type = Purchase Order, Main Line = true, with System Notes fields: Document Number, System Notes : Field, System Notes : New Value, System Notes : Set by, System Notes : Date.
Vendor Bills: Transaction search, Type = Bill, Main Line = true. Columns: Document Number, Reference No., Name, Date, Amount, Created From, Status.
Bill Payments: Transaction search, Type = Bill Payment, Main Line = false. Columns: Date, Applied To Transaction.
Vendors: Vendor search. Columns: Name, Tax Number, Date Created. Vendor Bank Details (optional, Electronic Bank Payments): Parent Vendor, IBAN.
Set the export user's time zone to Riyadh so System Notes dates are local time.
The profile reads dates as M/D/YYYY (NetSuite's default). If the export user's date format is D/M/YYYY, set date_order to dmy.
limits_hint: NetSuite purchase approval routing limits per employee
